correctness.rationale: Reconstructed finite-dimensional real positive Fremlin primal majorant/positive-contraction dual. For 0≤t≤1 all-ones rank-one majorant and identity contraction give 3. For 1≤t≤sqrt(phi), u=(1,t^-1,t^-2), v=(1,t,t²) majorize M_t at cost 1+t²+t^-2; explicit tridiagonal positive N saturates this and I-N^T N is a nonnegative ground-state sum of two squared differences with coefficients ab and bc. For t≥sqrt(phi), the dual rows split orthogonally into norm-one blocks while hxy^T majorizes M_t exactly at t^4≥t²+1, yielding 2sqrt(1+t²). Explicit one-sided derivatives match at 1,sqrt(phi), second derivatives differ. Independently computed primal dominance and dual spectral norms for 10 representative parameters including both sides of transitions. No general higher-dimensional assertion.
